name: Tennessee Eastman Separator Pressure (XMEAS08)
description: Product separator pressure in the Tennessee Eastman process. High separator pressure indicates control failure or feed composition upset. Checks whether pressure remains in operating band.

elements.name: Separator Pressure
elements.description: Product separator vessel pressure. Controlled by condenser coolant flow. Statistics from fault-free TEP dataset column 8 (XMEAS(8) in Downs-Vogel notation).

uncertainty.source: TEP fault-free dataset (Rieth et al. 2017, Harvard Dataverse). XMEAS08 column from d00.dat training set. Near-Gaussian with low variance under normal control. Fault IDV(4) causes step change in separator level (related variable) demonstrating sensitivity.

elements.name: Maximum Separator Pressure
elements.description: Upper pressure limit for separator vessel from TEP process description (Downs & Vogel 1993).

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(XMEAS08) = XMEAS08 if XMEAS08 <= XMEAS08_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The vessel pressure limit guards the separator pressure uncertainty set; pressures above 52.5 kPa trigger the high-pressure shutdown.
